attackers_goals: Adversaries may delete data to prevent the recovery of a corrupted system. They may also aim to interrupt availability to resources.
description: An identity deleted multiple S3 bucket objects from the project, considerably more than usual.
investigative_actions: Identify the deleted objects and their containing bucket. Investigate the identity that performed the deletion and review recent related activity.
